assets.label: GTA leadership background map
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: Pale editorial background map for the Fairlend leadership section
Primary request: Generate a polished pale editorial background map plate inspired by the reference crop, but geographically accurate to Toronto within the GTA. The map should show the central Toronto / downtown waterfront context, including Yorkville to the north, the Financial District near the center, Harbourfront and Lake Ontario toward the lower area, and a subtle CN Tower landmark marker. Use fine cream and warm-gray street linework, muted district labels, small orange proof pins, soft paper texture, low contrast, no UI cards, no webpage chrome, no unrelated text, no fantasy geography.
Input images: the crop is a reference image only. Generate a brand-new standalone asset; do not copy crop pixels.
Composition/framing: match the reference crop's subject, angle, aspect ratio, and visual weight.
Constraints: remove neighboring-page contamination, occluding unrelated assets, webpage framing, and collage leftovers.
Transparency/background: Generate as a clean standalone rectangular image asset.
Avoid: crop output, screenshot, full page mockup, browser frame, watermark, placeholder, unrelated typography.
assets.negative_prompt: Do not render quote cards, people, UI, browser chrome, fake city names, misspelled labels, dark roads, saturated colors, or a copied screenshot crop.
